dataset.test_ids: Every official test record, sorted sample_id; no exclusions

preprocessing.rgb: float32 RGB / 255, bilinear antialiased square resize
preprocessing.mask: nonzero class IDs -> binary; nearest resize to 128; normal zeros derived; original geometry checked
preprocessing.mask_disappearance: report any anomaly mask that becomes empty after fixed resize; do not adjust geometry

scoring.spatial: mean RGB squared residual [B,H,W], raw intensity-squared units
scoring.postprocessing: none; no smoothing or per-image normalization

baseline.fit: 315 training normals only; sample-ID ordered float64 sum, divide count, cast float32
baseline.spatial_and_image_scoring: same squared RGB residual and spatial mean as autoencoder
baseline.calibration: 68 calibration normals only; float64 q=.95 linear interpolation; own strict threshold; freeze numeric value and reference hash before test inference

metrics.ap: non-interpolated average precision, not trapezoidal PR area
metrics.single_class: AUROC and AP both null if either class absent
metrics.zero_denominator: precision/recall/F1/FPR null when their respective denominator is zero
metrics.pixel: exact pooled AUROC/AP over all 150 images at 128x128; normals included; 2457600 pixels; no subsampling
metrics.aupro: not computed: region metric implementation/validation deferred
metrics.pixel_threshold_metrics: not computed: no independent pixel threshold
metrics.uncertainty: 1000 paired stratified image bootstrap resamples seed42; percentile 2.5/97.5 for AE-minus-baseline AUROC/AP; conditional on image independence, not physical groups

leakage_review.procedure: Revalidate all image/pixel/mask hashes and split. For all 7946 prior flags compute aligned full RGB128 RMS and center-quarter RGB64 RMS plus center grayscale correlation. No model scores or labels used.
leakage_review.center_crop: fractional box x/y 0.25..0.75 of original; LANCZOS64
leakage_review.strong_candidate: full128 RMS<=.015 AND crop64 RMS<=.025 OR crop grayscale Pearson>=.995
leakage_review.visual_selection: union of first8 full-RMS rank, first8 crop-RMS rank, first8 SHA256(a|b) rank and every strong candidate; stable ID ties
leakage_review.stop_rule: Any confirmed duplicate/repeated acquisition compromising official test independence stops metrics; suspected similarity remains flagged; no silent membership changes
leakage_review.physical_independence: unverified; incomplete visual review is explicitly a residual limitation

cpu.latency: first normal validation image only, preloaded batch1; 5 warmups then100 serial repetitions per model; forward+score includes validation overhead, excludes decode; separate30 decode/resize repeats; report median/p95
cpu.memory: process peak working set; 2GiB observed ceiling; exact pooled metric arrays bounded

visualizations.selection: first4 test anomalies and first2 test normals by sample_id, independent of model scores
visualizations.heatmap: fixed blue-to-red linear clipped error [0,.05], display only

prohibitions: No AE retraining or threshold changes
